message: the working light and its direct actions lead the optional target strip

copy.strip-rule: Time = first exposure × 2^(band index × stop step). Band indices start at zero.
copy.strip-cover-help: Dim bars are covered. Their earlier exposure stays put.
copy.strip-difference-help: A shortfall can take more light. Extra light cannot be removed by another exposure; Undo changes the experiment.
copy.strip-neighbor-ratio-help: These are the gaps in the light already added, not the gaps between the targets. Local light can change their order.
copy.strip-finish-help: This adds each remaining mask exposure in order. Extra local light stays extra; Undo reverses the whole press.
copy.strip-target-comparison: Band 3: -16.00 seconds from target · no light; stop gap is undefined.
copy.strip-target-help: Seconds compare an addition. Stops compare a proportion of the target. These are light-time differences, not paper-density differences.
copy.strip-finish-band-help: Add only what this chosen band lacks against its target. This does not move a mask or remove extra light.
copy.strip-mask-finish-help: Each checked band receives only what its own target still needs. Extra light is left alone; unchecked bands and the successive mask stay put. Undo reverses the whole press.
copy.strip-mask-scale-help: Change only the checked bands’ accumulated light. This is a new timing experiment, not taking light back from a real print. Undo reverses the whole press.
copy.strip-mask-invert-help: Checked becomes unchecked, and unchecked becomes checked. No light is added until you press an exposure button.
copy.strip-mask-shift-help: Move the choices, not the light. Checks wrap from one end to the other; no exposure or Undo step is added.
copy.strip-mask-help: Checked bands receive the selected extra-light amount. The successive left-to-right mask stays where it was.
copy.strip-scale-help: Multiply every band’s accumulated light by the same factor. The covered bands stay covered. This is a new timing experiment, not taking light back from a real print.
copy.strip-match-kept-band-help: Scale every live band by the factor needed to match the chosen kept band. Both anchor exposures must be above zero. Masks and the kept strip stay put.
copy.strip-band-comparison: Keep a strip to compare this band.
copy.strip-band-comparison-help: Positive differences mean more light now; negative differences mean less. This compares exposure, not print darkness.
copy.strip-return-help: Return only the kept light amounts. The current spacing stays selected, and the mask sequence begins again. Undo brings back the interrupted strip.
